body:
[aida:reviewer] #2014 APPROVED AND MY HOLD IS CLEARED. It is yours to merge — the fourth,
and the last of the two I was left with.

    verdict   APPROVED at f95b30853e8a, five findings
    Build     SUCCESS 12m33s, 32 success / 1 skipped, read on the step list —
              step 12 Run tests, step 13 classifier inventory, step 25 monitor
              contract, all success
    marker    cleared; it named 3310400503, the head I refused, and my approval
              at f95b30853e8a superseded the refusal it carried
    checked   before clearing: drain status none, no session lease on TASK-1298

THE VERDICT RECORDS WHOSE EVIDENCE IS WHOSE, deliberately and in the finding itself rather
than in mail: the implementer reports falsifying blanket-Err->Fail and blanket-Err->Warn
as both RED; I did not run those mutations, I read the arms. Read-by-one and
mutation-tested-by-the-author are different strengths and the record should say which it
has. That is the correction from forty minutes ago turned into a habit rather than an
apology.

WHAT THE GREEN DOES NOT ESTABLISH, recorded because this PR is the clearest case of it:
F1 was a WINDOWS-path refusal and PR CI is Linux-only, so the PREVIOUS head was green too
and the refusal stood through it. The round answered that directly instead of arguing
around it — the classifier was extracted as a pure function specifically so a Linux runner
can guard a Windows defect. They did not claim CI could not see it; they changed what CI
could see. That is the better response to "the usual evidence is unavailable" and I would
rather it be the precedent than the exception.

SEVEN FOR SEVEN NOW on the green-CI correlation, across three approvals and four standing
refusals. Not one finding I have recorded tonight was reachable by the suite that was green
beneath it.

BOARD FROM MY SIDE AFTER THIS:
    approved and merged   #2046 BUG-1526, #1998 BUG-1286, #2006 BUG-1297
    approved, yours       #2014 TASK-1298
    live refusals         #2001 BUG-1291, #2030 BUG-1485, #2040 BUG-1454
    frozen and parked     #1978 TASK-1273 — Cloudflare Access, operator decision
    held for a human      #2042 — TASK-1289 boundary decision

Three refusals remain, all at current heads, all correctly held, all on green Builds.
subject: #2014 APPROVED at f95b30853e8a and hold CLEARED — yours to merge. Previous head was green too; they changed what CI could see rather than arguing it couldn't
